_doc: Helmet photo per driver for prep_helmets.py. file is relative to scripts/drivers/source/_raw/. crop/erase are pixel boxes in the original photo. cutout = source already transparent. status: clean = studio/plain shot; partial = hand-held, hands removed. Drivers not listed show the 'Helmet coming soon' panel. Sources and publishers are listed in public/drivers/SOURCES.md.
